scope: Johnson County food, housing, referral, maternal-child nutrition, and youth support resources

records.name: Johnson County Public Library Community Resources Directory
records.description: JCPL-curated directory connecting Johnson County residents to food pantries, free meals, housing support, homelessness services, WIC, referral lines, and related community assistance.
records.availability_notes: JCPL compiles external providers and does not operate most listed services. Eligibility, hours, documentation requirements, and program status should be verified with each provider. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Johnson County Helpline
records.description: Information and referral service providing contact information and guidance for Johnson County residents seeking food, medical, housing, and other social-service resources.
records.availability_notes: Contact details and service coverage should be verified before referral. Verified through JCPL's community resource page August 6, 2026.

records.name: Interchurch Food Pantry of Johnson County
records.description: Faith-based food pantry serving Johnson County residents from its Franklin location.
records.availability_notes: JCPL notes that proof of Johnson County residency with picture identification is required. Hours and documentation rules should be verified before referral. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Johnson County WIC
records.description: Local WIC program supporting eligible pregnant and postpartum women, infants, and children up to age five with nutrition services and family-health support.
records.availability_notes: Categorical eligibility includes pregnant and postpartum women, infants, and children through age five; income, residency, appointment, and documentation requirements should be confirmed. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Johnson County Blessing Boxes
records.description: Mapped network of self-serve blessing boxes offering nonperishable food items across Johnson County.
records.availability_notes: Individual box locations and inventory can change without notice; users should check the current map and expect variable supply. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: KIC-IT
records.description: Franklin-based organization serving unhoused and housing-unstable youth ages 16 to 25 through a drop-in center, hot meals, case management, transportation, and related support.
records.availability_notes: Age eligibility, drop-in hours, transportation coverage, and current program capacity should be confirmed before referral. Verified August 6, 2026.
